exact_statement: For every integer m>=2, let g_m=2[(OR_m x) AND (OR_m y)]-1 and F_m=2z[(OR_m x) AND (OR_m y)]-1 on independent uniform bits, where z is one fresh satisfied-bit indicator. With the exact pair prime table, fixed lambda_ij=1/m, beta=1/m and the source complete forest surrogate, the accepted distributed transfer and reconstructed one-control inequality give R_F <29 I_core(F), including inherited R_g, all nonempty-data sectors, ranks and control-only residual. The same-reference correction satisfies Psi/I(g_m)=(1/4)log2(m)+1/20+o(1), uniformly over permitted original posteriors. For any finite positive record system w_rho(t)=t^k_rho w_rho and scale-independent positive lift multipliers, the mass portion pR_t+Psi_t,beta depends only on alpha=t beta, provided both references are feasible and positive and all 2^r control subsets are retained. The entropy/reference overhead outside R and full FEI remain separate; no actual queue probability or optimal-cost lower bound is asserted.
